item.text: {"claim_scores":[{"claim_id":"c1","score":"1","rationale":"Uses `dspy.Signature(...)` with string signatures and no `custom_types`; all custom names are bound in the same caller-visible local scope inside `build()`."},{"claim_id":"c2","score":"1","rationale":"Defines function-local `LocalType` as a `pydantic.BaseModel`, builds a string signature with `LocalType`, and asserts the resolved annotation is that class."},{"claim_id":"c3","score":"1","rationale":"Defines nested `Box.Inner` as a `pydantic.BaseModel`, uses dotted `Box.Inner` in the signature, and asserts the annotation resolves to `Box.Inner`."},{"claim_id":"c4","score":"1","rationale":"Binds `Alias = Box.Inner`, uses `Alias` in the signature, and asserts the annotation resolves to that alias target."},{"claim_id":"c5","score":"1","rationale":"Tries unqualified `Inner`, expects failure, and captures the `ValueError`, proving the unbound nested name does not resolve."}],"question_score":100,"needs_regrade":false}
